mainEntity.name: What is the top photo editing software for 2024?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best overall photo editing software for 2024 is Adobe Lightroom. For those on a budget, GIMP is highly recommended as a free photo editing software, while Google Photos is ideal for beginners and casual users as an online photo editor. Adobe Photoshop is the top choice for graphic design and illustration. Adobe Lightroom Mobile excels in mobile photo editing, Adobe Photoshop Elements is great for hobbyists, and Apple Photos is best suited for beginner Apple users.

mainEntity.name: Which software is preferred by professionals for editing photos?

acceptedAnswer.text: For professional photo editing software, Adobe Photoshop is the top choice. Adobe Lightroom and Lightroom Classic are excellent for workflow management, and Adobe Express is ideal for hobbyists. DxO Photolab is also recommended for its superior noise reduction and camera profile corrections.

mainEntity.name: What is the leading photo editing app globally?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adobe Photoshop Lightroom is recognised as the premier photo editing app worldwide, available across various platforms including iOS and Android.

mainEntity.name: What does the future hold for photo editing?

acceptedAnswer.text: The future of photo editing is set to be revolutionised by artificial intelligence (AI). This advancement means that computers will not only perform standard adjustments like brightness and contrast but will also understand the essence of the photos, opening up new and exciting creative possibilities.
